proof_id_hash.description: Identifier hash of the proof that was revoked.

revoked_at.description: Ledger timestamp at which the proof became invalid on-chain.

revoked_ledger.description: Ledger sequence at which the proof became invalid on-chain.

by_admin.description: True when the admin revoked the proof via admin_revoke_proof; false when the issuer revoked it via revoke_proof.

epoch.description: Registry epoch after this revocation committed.

policy_version.description: Authority policy version in force when the revocation committed. Later policy changes never alter it.

actor_role.description: Role that authorized the revocation: Issuer or Admin.

authorization_domain.description: Hash binding the registry, actor role and policy version that authorized the revocation.

description: Published once a revocation commits, whether initiated by the issuer or the admin. A repeated revocation attempt fails before this point and publishes nothing. It also commits the authority policy version, actor role and authorization domain.
